title: RuneScape Dragonwilds: Biohazard Quest – Quick & Easy Tutorial!
author: RuneScape Universe
description:
Complete the Biohazard Quest in RuneScape: Dragonwilds with this quick and easy walkthrough! In this guide, I'll show you how to find Zanik, collect all 10 Corrupted Essence Samples, gather the required quest items, locate the Corrupted Chicken, and unlock the Zamorak Cape recipe along with 50 Infernal Fragments.

Thanks for watching! 🎮
Subscribe for more RuneScape Dragonwilds and OSRS adventures.

#RuneScape #RuneScapeUniverse #Dragonwilds #OSRS #RuneScapeGuides #DragonwildsGameplay #RuneScapeChallenges #RuneScapeTutorials

transcript.text: Hey guys, this is a quick tutorial on how to complete the Biohazard quest in RuneScape Dragon Wilds. First, I'm going
to show you fastest way to reach Zanik starting from the wise old man. Zanik is located in a prison cell inside a cave
in the Dorgesh-Kaan region. This is, in my opinion, the fastest way to reach her. Keep in mind that some gates may
still be closed for you, but you can simply use the Wind Step ability to get around them. You can also ignore all the
enemies along the way if you don't feel like fighting, just like I did in this tutorial.
Later on, you can open these gates to reach her much faster. The gates are located on the right side when you enter
the garrison area, making them a very convenient shortcut to the quest starting point.
Speak with Zanik to start the quest. She will ask you to gather 10 corrupted essence samples from corrupted ravens
scattered throughout the region. Now, I'll show you the locations of all the ravens so you can collect the samples as
quickly as possible. The first corrupted raven can be found at the entrance to the garrison area. You'll spot it
perched above the gates. Use a bow or a magic spell to take it down and collect a corrupted essence sample. Keep in mind
that you must kill the ravens to obtain the samples, so simply finding them won't be enough. The second raven is
close to the first one. Just head to the wise old man and you'll see another raven perched above the entrance gates.
Another raven is also located in the garrison area, but this time you'll need to reach the top of the tower. Just use
the Wind Step ability to jump across where I showed you and you should have no problem reaching it.
Another raven can be found in the pastures area. The path of the hill is easy to follow, but the biggest obstacle
here is the blue dragon waiting nearby. You can either quickly kill the Raven and run away or fight the dragon first
if you prefer. The choice is yours. The next Raven can be found in the grand hall area perched on top of a tower.
There are plenty of enemies around including an annoying zogre. I cleared a few enemies on the way, but decided to
skip the zogre since my main goal was to complete the quest as quickly as possible.
With about half of the region completed, I used the Nexus to travel to the menagerie area. Conveniently, the next
Raven can be found very close to the Nexus. Now head to the library area. Run past
the blue dragon and go down one floor. On the tower on this side, you'll find another corrupted Raven waiting for you.
Another Raven can be found in the cathedral area near the demon gates. It's located by the entrance to the cave
system from the opposite side. The same cave system where Zanik is imprisoned.
Another Raven can also be found in the cathedral area outside in the gardens. You'll spot it perched on top of a tree.
>> [snorts] >> The last Raven is also located in the cathedral area. You'll find it on the
second floor outside on the balcony of the tower structure. Now return to Zanic and speak with her
again. She will give you another task and ask you to collect three items: dragon blood, unholy water, twilight
lily. By now, you already know how to obtain dragon blood, so let's move on to the twilight lily. Just follow my route
as the twilight lily can be found in the nearby cave system.
Collect the Twilight Lily from here and you'll be done with this part of the quest. Next, head to the cathedral to
obtain the unholy water. You can ignore the enemies along the way if you don't feel like fighting. After that, either
return to your base if you already have dragon blood or kill a few dragons on the way to obtain it before heading back
to Zanik. Return to Zanik and give her all three items. For the final part of the quest, she will ask you to find a
chicken. To make this easier, I'll show you the exact route from the Nexus area. The chicken can be found in the Grand
Hall area perched on top of a roof. Just follow my route and you'll reach it quickly.
And here is the corrupted chicken. Interact with the chicken and choose option four, asking it to end the
corruption. Go through the dialogue and that's all there is to it. Now return to
Zanik and speak with her to complete the quest. As a reward, you'll receive one Zamorak cape and its crafting recipe, 50
infernal fragments. You can also trade 10 corrupted essence samples to the corrupted chicken for additional
infernal fragments. However, in my opinion, it's not really worth the effort as farming enemies around the
region is a much faster way to collect them. Thanks for watching this quick tutorial. I hope it helped you complete
the quest quickly and without any confusion. If you found the guide useful, don't forget to leave a like and
subscribe to support the channel. Feel free to leave a comment and let me know how your adventure went. Good luck and
I'll see you in the next video.
